{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers AND exclude those with age = -1
converted_customers = sales[(sales['converted'] == 1) & (sales['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Also compute the count of valid converted customers
count_converted_valid = len(converted_customers)

# Print both values
print(f'Mean age: {mean_age_converted}')
print(f'Count of converted customers with valid age: {count_converted_valid}')"}
